faqSection.title: Common Questions
faqSection.description: Key things to know before setting up your home ledger.

items.question: Does Umay work offline in a pantry or basement?
items.answer: Yes. Umay is an offline-ready PWA. Recently viewed lists are cached on your device, and any stock changes made offline are queued and synced automatically once you are back online.

items.question: Is my inventory data private?
items.answer: Every item, location, and activity record is strictly isolated by your user ID (UID), and all requests are validated on the server with session checks and Zod schemas.

items.question: How does lifecycle part tracking work?
items.answer: Link consumables like water filters, vacuum brushes, or batteries to their parent appliances. Set a time or usage lifespan, and log replacements in two taps while auto-deducting from spare stock.

items.question: Do I need a separate app to scan barcodes or QR labels?
items.answer: No. Built-in camera support (BarcodeDetector with @zxing/browser fallback) lets you scan product barcodes and shelf QR labels right inside Umay.
